name: FluentCRM
notes: Stores contacts' IP addresses anonymised and shows FluentCRM's own avatar instead of loading pictures from Gravatar and ui-avatars.com, which would receive a hash of each contact's email address or their name. Email open and click tracking stay as FluentCRM sets them.

_fluentcrm_compliance_settings.anonymize.label: Anonymize IP addresses in activity logs
_fluentcrm_compliance_settings.anonymize.description: Shortens visitors’ IP addresses before FluentCRM stores them.

_fluentcrm_compliance_settings.enable_gr.label: Enable Gravatar Service
_fluentcrm_compliance_settings.enable_gr.description: Loads contacts’ photos from Gravatar, which sends a hash of each email to Gravatar.

_fluentcrm_compliance_settings.gravatar_.label: Use Gravatar fallback image
_fluentcrm_compliance_settings.gravatar_.description: Uses Gravatar’s picture for contacts without a photo.
